title: WISDOM Project - XXI. Giant molecular clouds in the central region of the barred spiral galaxy NGC 613: a steep size-linewidth relation
question: Whether giant molecular clouds in and around the nuclear ring of the barred spiral galaxy NGC 613 exhibit a steep size-linewidth relation and enhanced linewidths, and what physical mechanisms drive their dynamical state and properties.

recipe.goal: Generate moment maps and define galactic sub-regions
recipe.method: Smooth-moment masking method: convolve 12CO(1-0) cube spatially with a Gaussian of synthesised beam width and Hanning-smooth spectrally, select pixels > 3x RMS of smoothed cube as mask, apply to original cube to generate moment 0, 1, 2 maps; divide central region into nucleus, arcs, nodes, and dust lanes.
key_parameters: Mask threshold = 3x RMS noise of smoothed cube; Nucleus radius <= 180 pc; Arcs velocity dispersion 0 - 25 km s^-1; Nodes velocity dispersion >= 25 km s^-1

recipe.method: Run modified CPROPSTOO algorithm on the central 15'' x 15'' region of the 12CO(1-0) cube to identify 3D cloud structures and classify them as spatially and spectrally resolved or unresolved.
key_parameters: high-threshold = 4.5 sigma_rms, low-threshold = 2.0 sigma_rms, minvchan = 2, convexity = 0.65, Delta T_max = 2 sigma_rms = 2.20 K, minarea = 120 to 24 spaxels (step 24)

recipe.goal: Calculate GMC physical properties and uncertainties
recipe.method: Extrapolate moments to infinite sensitivity (T_edge = 0 K), deconvolve spatial beam and spectral channel width to compute cloud radius R_c, observed linewidth sigma_obs,los, gradient-subtracted linewidth sigma_gs,los, CO luminosity L_CO(1-0), gas mass M_gas, and surface density Sigma_gas; estimate uncertainties via 500 bootstrap resamplings.
key_parameters: 500 bootstrap resamplings; Delta V_chan = 2 km s^-1
assumptions: Geometric parameter eta = 1.91; Distance D = 17.5 Mpc; CO-to-molecule conversion factor X_CO = 2 x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1 (alpha_CO(1-0) = 4.4 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1)

recipe.goal: Fit size-linewidth and virial mass-gas mass scaling relations
recipe.method: Compute Spearman rank correlation, fit power-law relations between R_c and sigma_obs,los using Linmix and ODR, compute virial mass M_obs,vir and virial parameter alpha_obs,vir, fit power law between M_obs,vir and M_gas, and evaluate external pressure tracks in Sigma_gas vs sigma_obs,los R_c^-1/2 plane.
assumptions: Geometrical factor b_s = 1/5 assuming homogeneous spherical clouds

recipe.goal: Estimate energetics, timescales, and azimuthal cloud evolution in the nuclear ring
recipe.method: Calculate bar-driven mass inflow rates, kinetic energy injection rate E_dot_in,total, turbulent energy dissipation rate E_dot_diss, turbulence dissipation timescale t_diss, inter-node travel time t_travel, cloud-cloud collision timescale t_coll, shear timescale t_shear, and characteristic cloud lifetime t_lifetime from azimuthal cloud number drop between nodes.
key_parameters: Inflow width W_in = 100 pc; Nuclear ring radius R_NR = 270 pc; Circular velocity V_c,NR = 170 km s^-1; Annulus inner semi-major axis = 240 pc, outer = 385 pc, ellipticity = 0.3
assumptions: Gas on circular orbits in nuclear ring; flat rotation curve in outer disc; cloud-cloud velocity dispersion sigma_cc = 10 km s^-1; negligible cloud formation between nodes

rediscovery_reason: Public archival ALMA data (2017.1.01671.S) with well-specified imaging and cloud-identification parameters and clear numeric answer keys (158 resolved GMCs, size-linewidth slope 0.77 +- 0.11, mean virial parameter 1.66).
